newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-CellPro cut, stock falls.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-CellPro cut, stock falls.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Marc Ostro cut his rating of CellPro to hold from buy on Wednesday after a jury ruled late on Tuesday that the company had infringed on patents held by Baxter International Inc, Becton Dickinson and Co and Johns Hopkins School of Medicine.
-- In a research report, Ostro said a ruling in favor of Baxter was expected, but the jury also ruled the infringment was willful, which can result in triple damages.

-- "This was surprising since typically opinions of non-infringement by a qualified qualified patent lawyer (a document which CellPro had obtained) preclude the willful infringment claim," he wrote in a report.
-- "Given this unpredictability, we are not sure that an injunction is not possible and ... have downgraded the stock ... until the dust settles," he said in the report.
-- Shares fell sharply, losing 20 percent of their value with the stock off 1-5/8 to 6-1/2 in early trading.
